test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Trains P and Q are running in the same direction on parallel tracks with speeds of x km/h and 90 km/h (90 > x), respectively. The faster train passes a man sitting in the slower train in 30 seconds. If the length of train Q is 225 m, then what is the value of x ?
solution:
Given:

Speed of the faster train (Q) = 90 kmph

Speed of the slower train (P) = x kmph

Length of the train Q = 225m

Concept used:

While going in the same direction, the relative speed of two objects is the difference between their individual speeds.

Speed × Time = Distance

If a train passes a man, it passes its own length.
